data.one_liner: Generator for OpenAPI client SDKs in Dart and Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Generates API client SDKs directly from local or remote OpenAPI specifications using build_runner. It acts as a wrapper around the Java-based OpenAPI Generator CLI to integrate seamlessly into Dart and Flutter development workflows.
use_when: You have an OpenAPI specification (JSON or YAML) and need to generate a matching Dart client SDK.
You want automated synchronization of your API client when the backend OpenAPI spec updates.
avoid_when: You do not have Java installed on your system (Java 8 or higher is required).
You prefer writing your REST API clients manually.
strengths: Automates client SDK generation from standard OpenAPI specs.
Supports both local file and remote URL specifications with caching.
weaknesses: Requires Java to be installed and available in the system PATH.
Issues with generated code often need to be addressed in the base OpenApi library rather than this wrapper.
data.setup_notes: Requires Java (version 8 or higher) installed in your system PATH. Add openapi_generator_annotations to dependencies and openapi_generator to dev_dependencies, then run build_runner.
